                  ExecutionSummarizer.stringifyDataStatistics(dataStats), 
@@ -272,7 +272,7 @@ public void testExecutionSummarizer() throws IOException {

                 dataStats, conf);

Root cause: The test case `testExecutionSummarizer` in `TestGridmixSummary` was failing due to a mismatch in the expected format of the expected data size.
